caveats: The Q4 value is derived (annual figure less the nine-month year-to-date figure), not separately reported as a standalone quarter.
Disney's fiscal Q4 2024 runs from 2024-06-30 to 2024-09-28.

claims.text: Disney's net cash provided by operating activities in fiscal Q4 2024 was $5.518 billion. It is derived as fiscal-year 2024 operating cash flow of $13.971 billion minus nine-month operating cash flow of $8.453 billion.

raw_output.summary: Disney's net cash provided by operating activities in fiscal Q4 2024 (2024-06-30 to 2024-09-28) was about $5.518 billion. This is a derived figure: full-year fiscal 2024 operating cash flow minus the first nine months.
